$comment: Signed-mirror pins for vendored installer payloads (tempdoc 760/772 §K sign-once). Each entry pairs a signed, re-hosted mirror URL with its sha256 for one vendored payload. Committed HERE (not in repo variables) so every pin change is PR-reviewed history, preserving the supply-chain audit trail the hardcoded gradle pins already provide. build-installer.yml reads this file and, for each COMPLETE entry, exports the matching gradle override property pair (ORG_GRADLE_PROJECT_<name>) for the packaging build; an absent entry or an empty 'mirrors' object sets nothing, so the build is byte-identical to the default pinned upstream download. A HALF-complete entry (url without sha256, or vice versa) fails the build loudly BEFORE it starts, mirroring the all-or-nothing pin enforcement in modules/ui/build.gradle.kts (a mirror URL paired with the default hash can never verify; the default URL paired with a mirror hash would reject the genuine pinned artifact). Entry shape -> gradle override pair: "llama-cpu": {"url": "https://.../llama-<ver>-...-signed.zip", "sha256": "<hex>"} -> llamaPrebuiltUrlOverride / llamaPrebuiltSha256Override; "tesseract": {"url": "https://.../tesseract-<ver>-...-signed.zip", "sha256": "<hex>"} -> tesseractSourceUrlOverride / tesseractSourceSha256Override. Ships EMPTY; populate per pin bump per the per-pin-bump procedure in docs/how-to/cut-a-release.md.
